subject: Science
overview: Indha lesson-la living things-oda characteristics, seed germination, plant life cycle, mosquito matrum frog life cycles-ai paappom. Living things grow, breathe, respond, reproduce matrum life stages moolama change aagum-nu examples-oda purinjukkolvom.
learning_objectives: Living things-oda mukkiya characteristics-ai list panna mudiyum.
Seed germination-kku thevaiyana conditions-ai identify panna mudiyum.
Plant life cycle stages-ai order-la describe panna mudiyum.
Mosquito matrum frog life cycles-ai compare panna mudiyum.
Living things-oda habitat-ai protect panna ways solla mudiyum.

teaching_sequence.title: Living-aa, non-living-aa?
teaching_sequence.caption: Namma sutri irukkura objects-ai observe pannunga. Plants, animals grow aagum, nutrients thevai, breathe pannum, stimuli-kku respond pannum. Stone madhiri non-living objects indha life processes-ai seiyaadhu. Wooden log tree-lirundhu vandhaalum ippo grow aagadhu.
teaching_sequence.teacher_says: Oru plant-aiyum oru stone-aiyum compare pannunga. Plant grow aagum, water thevai; stone indha processes seiyaadhu. Movement mattum living-nu decide panna podhaadhu.
teaching_sequence.checkpoint: Living thing-ai identify panna help pannura rendu characteristics sollunga. Wooden log ippo living-aa? Yen?

teaching_sequence.title: Living things-oda characteristics
teaching_sequence.caption: Living organisms movement, nutrition, growth, respiration, excretion, response to stimuli, reproduction matrum death kaattum. Oru characteristic mattum paathu mudivu edukkaama, full set-ai consider pannuvom.
teaching_sequence.teacher_says: Plant sunlight pakkam bend aagalam; animals food thedi move pannum. Living things environment-kku respond pannum, energy use pannum, grow aagum.
teaching_sequence.checkpoint: Living things-oda naangu characteristics sollunga. Stimulus-kku response-na enna?

teaching_sequence.title: Seed germination
teaching_sequence.caption: Seed germinate aaga water, air, suitable temperature thevai. Water seed coat-ai soften pannum; embryo grow start pannum. Root usually keezha valarum; shoot mela valarum. Light/dark requirement seed type-ai poruththu maaralaam.
teaching_sequence.teacher_says: Bean seeds-ai damp cotton-la vechu daily observe pannunga. Water mattum podhuma? Air-um suitable temperature-um yen mukkiyam-nu discuss pannuvom.
teaching_sequence.checkpoint: Seed germination-kku thevaiyana moonu conditions enna? Root-um shoot-um endha direction-la valarum?

teaching_sequence.title: Plant life cycle
teaching_sequence.caption: Plant life cycle seed germination-la start aagi seedling, mature plant, flowering, fruit matrum seed production stages-ai kadakkum. Pudhu seeds suitable conditions kidaikkumbodhu germinate aagi cycle continue aagum.
teaching_sequence.teacher_says: Oru bean plant photo series-la seed-lirundhu flower, fruit varai stages-ai arrange pannunga. Ovvoru stage-la enna change nadakkudhu-nu sollunga.
teaching_sequence.checkpoint: Plant life cycle-la flowering-kku appuram enna nadakkum? Pudhu plant eppadi start aagum?

teaching_sequence.title: Mosquito life cycle
teaching_sequence.caption: Mosquito life cycle-la egg, larva, pupa, adult-nu naangu stages irukkum. Larva-um pupa-um water-la irukkum; surface-kku vandhu air edukkum. Stagnant water breeding place aagalam; water collect aagama vechikkaradhu mukkiyam.
teaching_sequence.teacher_says: Stagnant water irukkura containers-ai adult supervision-oda check pannalaam. Larva-um pupa-um different shapes-la irukkum. Avatrai touch pannaama teacher-kitta report pannunga.
teaching_sequence.checkpoint: Mosquito life cycle-oda naangu stages-ai correct order-la sollunga. Stagnant water-ai remove pannuvadhu yen help pannum?

teaching_sequence.title: Frog life cycle
teaching_sequence.caption: Frog life cycle spawn/eggs-lirundhu embryo, tadpole, legs develop aana tadpole, froglet, adult frog varai progress aagum. Tadpole water-la vaazhum; tail swimming-kku help pannum. Froglet land-layum water-layum move panna aarambikkum.
teaching_sequence.teacher_says: Textbook diagram-la frog stages-ai observe pannunga. Tadpole-ku tail yen thevai? Growth nadakkumbodhu legs eppadi develop aagudhu-nu trace pannunga.
teaching_sequence.checkpoint: Tadpole-um adult frog-um body structure-la enna difference? Tail tadpole-kku eppadi help pannum?

teaching_sequence.title: Life cycles compare pannuvom
teaching_sequence.caption: Plants, mosquitoes, frogs ellam life cycle stages moolama change aagum. Mosquito-um frog-um egg stage-la start aanaalum, stages-um habitat changes-um different. Frog tadpole water-la vaazhum; adult frog water-um land-um use pannum.
teaching_sequence.teacher_says: Mosquito matrum frog life cycle diagrams-ai side-by-side compare pannunga. Common stages, different stages, habitat changes-ai table-la note pannunga.
teaching_sequence.checkpoint: Mosquito-um frog-um life cycle-la oru similarity, rendu differences sollunga.

teaching_sequence.title: Living world-ai protect pannuvom
teaching_sequence.caption: Plants, animals avanga habitat-oda depend aagirukkanga. Stagnant water-ai manage pannudhal, plants-ai care pannudhal, habitats-ai disturb pannaama iruththal living things-ai protect pannum. Observe pannumbodhu safety follow pannunga.
teaching_sequence.teacher_says: Garden-la plant growth observe pannalaam; pond animals-ai distance-la irundhu paarkkanum. Nature-ai protect pannuvadhum science learning-oda oru part.
teaching_sequence.checkpoint: Living things-oda habitat-ai protect panna neenga seiya koodiya rendu actions sollunga.
